title: A privacy data set quality assessment method and system
assignee: South China University of Technology SCUT

pse.problem: Evaluation of privacy data set quality in a private state without revealing plaintext data or modifying the evaluation results.
pse.solution_function: A method that modifies a federated learning neural network model into a data quality assessment model, uses zero-knowledge proof protocol to generate and verify data quality certificates, ensuring the accuracy of the inference results.
pse.solution_structure: Training data set (valid and random invalid data), data quality assessment neural network, zk-SNARK key generation algorithm, Pedersen commitment algorithm.
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Merge valid and random invalid data into a training data set; 2. Modify the last fully connected layer of the federated learning neural network model to create a data quality assessment neural network; 3. Train the data quality assessment neural network based on the training data set; 4. Quantify the operation data of the data quality assessment model and convert it into unsigned integers; 5. Apply zk-SNARK key generation algorithm to generate proof and verification keys corresponding to the data quality assessment model; 6. Use zero-knowledge proof protocol and Pedersen commitment algorithm to generate Pedersen commitments of input data, evaluation results, and the proof of the data verification process as data quality proof.
pse.effect: Improves efficiency and accuracy of private data quality assessment while maintaining privacy.
